name: MBPO Broadway Storefront Vacancy Survey 2020
description:
This dataset is a street-level survey of storefront vacancy along Broadway in Manhattan, collected in 2020 by the Manhattan Borough President's Office. Each of the roughly 385 sampled rows represents a single storefront and records its address, the business name where one could be identified (missing for nearly half the records), and the visual evidence of vacancy—most commonly a "For Rent/For Lease" sign, followed by an empty space, closed-until-further-notice notices, covered windows, or permanent closure. It also notes whether the storefront was boarded up and which side of Broadway it sits on.

Each record is geocoded with latitude and longitude and linked to standard New York City administrative geographies: community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot (BBL), neighborhood tabulation area (NTA), and postcode. All records are in Manhattan, with the Upper West Side, Midtown South, and SoHo/T
